source: every COBJ record across 101 plugins in load order, and the records their CNAM and BNAM point at
readFrom: BNAM is the workbench keyword, CNAM is the output item, NAM1 is how many it makes, COCT and CNTO are the inputs, CTDA is the conditions the server evaluates itself
event: mp.onCraft(actorFormId, craftedItemBaseId, count, recipeId). recipeId is the key of this table. Returning false refuses the craft outright: CraftEvent::OnFireSuccess is what removes the inputs and adds the output, and GameModeEvent::Fire only calls it when nobody blocked.
default: a recipe id this table does not carry is one nobody owns, and anybody may make it
fires: false means the server is never asked about this recipe. CraftService::RecipeItemsMatch throws out the armour table (adb78) and the sharpening wheel (88108) before it considers anything, so tempering never reaches onCraft.

cannotCraftYet.Warrior/Bulwark: warriors do not craft. Bulwark and Berserker are halves of how somebody fights, and classes.md gives them combat maneuvers rather than recipes. There is nothing in the records to find.
cannotCraftYet.Warrior/Berserker: the same. Warrior is the one profession whose halves are not about making anything.
cannotCraftYet.Alchemist/Blightbrewer: Skyrim has no alchemy recipes. Not one COBJ record in the whole load order names an alchemy bench keyword: potions are worked out from the effects that the ingredients share, in the alchemy menu, and no record is involved. The poison bit that would split this half from the Physicker is proved and ready in the code above, so the moment a mod adds an alchemy bench recipe it lands here by itself.
cannotCraftYet.Alchemist/Physicker: the same. There is nothing for this table to gate until alchemy is answered somewhere other than a recipe record.
cannotCraftYet.Enchanter/Wardweaver: the only enchanting recipes in the build are the 160 staff recipes on the Dragonborn staff enchanter, and a staff is a weapon, so they all land on the Bladebinder. Enchanting a cuirass or a robe is the enchanting menu and not a record, so the Wardweaver has nothing to own here.
